description: BENE.BIZ Multi-Card KPIs visual lets you build multiple modern KPI cards at once — a compact, customizable way to present key metrics in your Power BI reports. Create one or more KPI cards arranged in rows or columns. Display comparison metrics. Configure data and category labels, add icons, and fine‑tune fonts, colors, borders, and spacing. Looking to show many KPIs without clutter? The BENE.BIZ Multi-Card KPIs delivers a flexible, design-friendly grid with comparison metrics and optional dynamic border strips to highlight performance — all while remaining highly customizable to match your report’s look and feel. Free features You can use the BENE.BIZ Multi-Card KPIs for free with the following features: Single KPI card — Display one KPI with data value and category label, plus an optional icon. Card customization — Configure background, border, corner radius, and basic spacing. Text and icon styling — Control label fonts and colors; add a custom icon (URL or Base64 string) with size and transparency. 💎 PRO features The PRO version of the BENE.BIZ Multi-Card KPIs unlocks additional features, including: Multiple KPI cards — Create up to 10 KPI cards in a single visual. Orientation control — Arrange cards horizontally (rows) or vertically (columns). Card spacing — Precisely control spacing between cards for balanced layouts.
